## In one sentence

Unsupervised learning summarises or groups data without a supplied outcome label.

## Clustering

Clustering assigns observations to groups according to a similarity rule.
K-means minimises within-cluster squared distance for a chosen number of groups;
hierarchical methods build a tree of nested groupings. Results depend on
scaling, distance, algorithm, and the chosen number of clusters.

## Dimension reduction

Principal component analysis finds directions that capture variance in numeric
data. A low-dimensional representation can help visualise structure, but high
variance is not always the same as scientific importance.

::: {.callout-important}
A cluster is a model-based or algorithmic summary, not automatically a natural
species, subgroup, or causal mechanism. Check stability and external validity.
:::

## Check your understanding

Run a clustering thought experiment with two features measured in different
units. Explain why scaling could change the groups.
